parameters.name: GwClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the gateway instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

- **30**

- **50**

- **100**. The default value is **30**.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the rate limit policy.

parameters.name: ScopeRefId
parameters.description: The ID of the target resource, which can be a consumer group or a consumer, depending on the `ScopeType` value.

parameters.name: ScopeType
parameters.description:
The scope of the rate limit policy. Valid values:

- **ConsumerGroup**: The policy applies to a consumer group.

- **Consumer**: The policy applies to a specific consumer.
